locations.metaTitle: AI Automation Company in Miami, FL | AI Consulting | DELAI
locations.metaDesc: DELAI is an AI automation company in Miami. We build AI workflow automation, internal tools, and connected systems for small and medium businesses across Miami-Dade County.
locations.lead: We build AI workflow automation and internal systems for Miami businesses — on-site in Brickell, Doral, Coral Gables, and everywhere else in Miami-Dade.
locations.body: Miami companies grow fast and accumulate software faster. The usual result is a twelve-person team running operations across a CRM nobody trusts, three shared inboxes, WhatsApp, and a spreadsheet that one person maintains. DELAI comes in, maps how the work actually moves, and rebuilds the worst of it as software that runs on its own.

locations.metaTitle: AI Automation for Miami-Dade County Businesses | DELAI
locations.metaDesc: DELAI builds AI automation, internal tools, and connected operational systems for businesses across Miami-Dade County — Doral, Hialeah, Coral Gables, Kendall, and Aventura.
locations.lead: Workflow automation, internal tools, and connected systems for companies across Miami-Dade — from Doral warehouses to Coral Gables offices.
locations.body: Miami-Dade is where most of our on-site work happens, and the pattern repeats across industries: a capable team, six systems that don't talk to each other, and a coordinator holding it together by hand. We start with the process costing the most hours, rebuild it properly, then move to the next one.

locations.metaTitle: Fort Lauderdale Business Automation & AI Consulting | DELAI
locations.metaDesc: Fort Lauderdale business automation from DELAI. AI workflow automation, process automation, and custom internal tools for companies across Broward County.
locations.lead: Business process automation and AI systems for Fort Lauderdale companies — from Las Olas to Oakland Park, on-site across Broward.
locations.body: Fort Lauderdale runs on service businesses: marine, construction, real estate, legal, medical. Every one of them has the same bottleneck — coordination. Requests, quotes, scheduling, approvals, and follow-up, all moving by hand. That's exactly the work we automate first, because it pays for itself fastest.

locations.h1: AI Workflow Automation in Broward County
locations.metaTitle: AI Workflow Automation for Broward County Businesses | DELAI
locations.metaDesc: DELAI builds AI workflow automation for small and medium businesses across Broward County — Hollywood, Pembroke Pines, Coral Springs, Weston, and Fort Lauderdale.
locations.lead: AI workflow automation for small and medium businesses across Broward County — Hollywood, Pembroke Pines, Coral Springs, Weston, and everywhere between.
locations.body: Broward is full of thirty-to-eighty person companies that outgrew their tooling three years ago and never got a chance to fix it. You don't need a platform migration. You need the four processes that consume the most hours rebuilt properly. We start with one, prove it, then keep going.

locations.h1: AI Systems for Palm Beach County Businesses
locations.metaTitle: AI Automation & Consulting in Palm Beach County | DELAI
locations.metaDesc: AI automation and custom software for Palm Beach County businesses — Boca Raton, West Palm Beach, Delray Beach, and Jupiter. Built and operated by DELAI.
locations.lead: AI systems, internal tools, and process automation for Palm Beach County — Boca Raton, West Palm Beach, Delray Beach, and Jupiter.
locations.body: Palm Beach County has an unusual concentration of small firms doing high-value work: wealth management, specialty medical, luxury property, professional services. The margin isn't in headcount, it's in what your existing team can handle without dropping anything. That's an automation problem, and it's the one we solve.

locations.h1: AI Automation in West Palm Beach
locations.metaTitle: West Palm Beach AI Automation & Custom Software | DELAI
locations.metaDesc: DELAI builds AI workflow automation and internal tools for West Palm Beach businesses, working on-site across Palm Beach County.
locations.lead: Process automation and internal tools for West Palm Beach companies, on-site across Palm Beach County.
locations.body: West Palm Beach firms tend to be small, senior, and busy — which means nobody has a spare month to fix operations. We work in short cycles: one process at a time, running in production, with your team trained on it before we move on.

locations.h1: AI Systems for Boca Raton Businesses
locations.metaTitle: Boca Raton AI Automation & Business Systems | DELAI
locations.metaDesc: AI systems, internal tools, and process automation for Boca Raton businesses — designed, built, and operated by DELAI.
locations.lead: AI systems, internal tools, and process automation for Boca Raton, on-site across south Palm Beach County.
locations.body: Boca has a dense mix of professional firms, medical practices, and small software companies. Most already have decent tooling. What's missing is the connective layer and the handful of automations that let the same team handle more without dropping anything.
